AC Remodeling — Design-Build Kitchen, Bathroom & Basement Remodeling in MD & DC
Built around the way you live.

For over 15 years, AC Remodeling has helped homeowners across Montgomery County and Northwest DC transform the way they live. We bring together thoughtful design, master-led craftsmanship and a genuinely collaborative process to create spaces that are as functional as they are beautiful.

REQUEST MY CONSULTATION
VIEW PORTFOLIO
“

“A.C. Remodeling did a great job remodeling my kitchen and bathrooms. It was a pleasure working with Alex, Carolina and the whole crew.”

Barbara Kriss

FULL-SERVICE REMODELING

From concept to completion.

We manage every detail of your project with precision, transparency and a commitment to quality that lasts.

Kitchen Remodeling

Custom cabinetry, stone surfaces and lighting designed around how you actually cook and gather.

Bathroom Remodeling

Spa-quality primary baths with warm stone, frameless glass and lighting that flatters.

Basement Remodeling

Basements that feel like the rest of the house — warm, dry, bright and fully permitted.

Design Build

One accountable team, from first sketch through completion.

OUR WORK

Step inside a finished project.

Choose a collection to see the full photo set — every detail, from demolition-day decisions to the final install.

Kitchen in Bethesda

BETHESDA, MD

Designed for both functional cooking and entertaining, this warm two-tone kitchen pairs cream perimeter cabinets with a rich stained wood center island. Quartz Sono Soleil counters and warm brass fixtures create a seamless blend of timeless character and modern luxury.

VIEW PROJECT
White Kitchen in Bethesda

BETHESDA, MD

This full kitchen remodel features sleek white cabinetry paired with luxurious Quartzite Matarazzo countertops and a seamless waterfall edge. Custom storage solutions and elegant brass accents complete this dream kitchen for our clients.

VIEW PROJECT
Hall Bath & Master Bathroom in Gaithersburg

GAITHERSBURG, MD

Master Suite: A spa-inspired oasis centered around a freestanding tub, rich navy dual-sink cabinetry, backlit mirrors, and an expansive quartzite-look porcelain walk-in shower. Hall Bath: Features coastal-inspired tilework, a teal glass mosaic accent, and high-contrast matte black fixtures. Together, these renovations effortlessly blend high design with everyday practicality.

VIEW PROJECT
Primary Bath in Rockville

ROCKVILLE, MD

Blending soothing tones with high-end finishes, this primary bath renovation pairs an Ocean White Matte Beyond Calacatta backsplash with bright white shaker cabinetry for an airy, spa-like feel. The modern walk-in shower is enclosed in frameless glass and features textured wave wall tile, brushed nickel fixtures, and safety grab bars for the ultimate daily getaway.

VIEW PROJECT
View all projects

OUR CORE TEAM

Founder-led, on site every day.

AC Remodeling is a family-owned design-build firm founded in Gaithersburg in 2009. No middle management — the owners run your project.

Alex Reyes

PRESIDENT & CEO

Licensed contractor and unabashed perfectionist. Alex is on site daily, holding construction quality, materials and detailing to his own standard.

“I pride myself on high-quality work, never cutting corners, and paying the utmost attention to details.”

Carolina Reyes

MANAGING DIRECTOR

Carolina leads design direction, joins every client meeting and translates your wish list into a plan our build team can deliver on budget.

“We are here for you. Our top priority is making your life easier through the whole project.”

Melissa Rojas

DESIGN ASSISTANT

Melissa guides you through selections and showroom visits, balancing beauty and function down to the last tile, fixture and finish.

“I am my happiest when creating a space that brings you joy.”

FROM VISION TO REALITY

Every great renovation starts with a great plan.

Our design-build team makes remodeling simple, transparent and enjoyable from start to finish. From your initial consultation to custom 3D designs, material selections, construction and the final walkthrough, we handle every detail under one roof — so you always know what to expect.

01
Consultation

We learn about your vision, goals, timeline and budget.

02
Design

Custom layouts and realistic 3D renderings bring your ideas to life.

03
Material Selection

Expert guidance choosing finishes, fixtures, cabinetry and more.

04
Construction

Professional craftsmanship with clear communication throughout your project.

05
Enjoy Your New Home

A final review ensures every detail exceeds expectations.

Why homeowners
trust AC Remodeling.

One team draws it, prices it, permits it and builds it — so nothing falls between the plan and the punch list.

REQUEST MY CONSULTATION

Integrated design-build under one contract
Design, engineering, permitting and construction live with one accountable team — 15+ years of remodeling homes across Montgomery County and Northwest DC, with local codes and permits handled for you.
02
Master-led craftsmanship and premium materials
Long-tenured carpenters and tile setters who work only on our projects, supported by vetted cabinetry shops, stone yards and fixture partners — no builder-grade substitutions.
03
Clear communication, backed in writing
One dedicated project manager, weekly written progress reports, a shared schedule and same-day responses — plus a multi-year workmanship warranty from a company that answers the phone.

KITCHEN REMODELING

KITCHEN REMODELING

Kitchens designed as architecture.

Designed, priced and built by one team.

Request My Consultation
View Portfolio
One team from design to completion.

Most kitchen projects fail in the gap between the designer and the builder. We remove the gap: the same firm draws your kitchen, pulls the permits and builds it with our own long-tenured crew.

You review a 3D rendering and a detailed proposal before demolition. From there you have one project manager, a written weekly update and a schedule you can plan your life around.

WHAT'S INCLUDED

Where the craftsmanship shows.
Cabinetry

Custom and semi-custom cabinetry, primarily in painted maple, with a range of stains, woods and finishes to match your style. Full-overlay, soft-close construction throughout.

Stone & surfaces

Quartzite and engineered quartz, precisely measured and seamed where you won't see it. Chosen for durability as much as beauty.

Lighting

Layered ceiling, task and accent lighting on dimmers, thoughtfully planned for how the room is actually used.

Storage plan

Every drawer assigned before we order: spice pull-outs, appliance garages, tray dividers, hidden waste and pantry systems.

Structure & systems

Wall removals, beams, HVAC re-routing, panel upgrades and new plumbing handled under one permit and one contract.

Appliance integration

Panel-ready refrigeration and ventilation sized to your range, with rough-ins coordinated closely with the appliance dealer.

TIMELINE

What to expect, week by week.
01
Design & selections

Measurements, 3D plans, material selections and a detailed proposal.

3–5 weeks
02
Permitting & ordering

County permits filed, cabinetry and long-lead items released.

3–6 weeks
03
Construction

Demolition, rough-ins, inspections, cabinetry, stone, tile and finishes.

6–9 weeks
04
Final detailing & handoff

Final detailing, deep clean, care guide and warranty handoff.

1 week

OUR DESIGN-BUILD PROCESS

Transform your home with confidence.

Your home should reflect the way you live today. Whether you're remodeling a kitchen, bathroom, basement or creating a complete home renovation, our experienced design-build team guides you through every step, from the first conversation to completion.

Request My Consultation
View Portfolio

CONCEPT TO REALITY

Transform your dreams into reality.

The experienced design and build team at AC Remodeling is ready to bring your fully remodeled kitchen, bathroom and basement dreams to life.

Imagine your custom makeover with modern finishes, smart home technology and every convenience for the ultimate in luxury. Trust us to listen to your ideas, make recommendations and guide you every step of the way.

Our designers will advise you on color combinations and accompany you to choose materials for a stress-free process. Once you make your selections, we will present you with a realistic 3D image so you can visualize your exciting new design.

REQUEST MY CONSULTATION

STEP BY STEP

Every step, explained.
01
Initial Consultation

Every successful renovation starts with a conversation.

During your initial no-obligation consultation, we'll learn about your goals, lifestyle, design preferences, timeline and investment range. We'll evaluate your space, answer your questions and discuss what's possible based on your vision.

WHAT YOU'LL RECEIVE

In-home or virtual consultation
Professional evaluation of your space
Budget and project planning guidance
Expert recommendations
Clear next steps
02
Design & Planning

This is where your vision starts to come to life.

Design begins with a signed design agreement and a design retainer, which covers measured drawings, 3D renderings, engineering coordination and the selections work that follow. The retainer is credited toward your construction contract when you move forward with us. From there, our designers carefully measure your space and create detailed 3D renderings that let you see your future renovation before construction begins. We refine every detail together — from layout and functionality to finishes and aesthetics — until you're completely confident in the design. Once approved, we finalize the project scope and prepare everything needed for construction.

OUR DESIGN PROCESS INCLUDES

Signed design agreement and design retainer
Detailed site measurements
Professional 3D renderings
Space planning and layout optimization
Design revisions
Final project specifications
03
Material Selection

Choosing finishes should be exciting — not overwhelming.

We guide you through selecting cabinets, countertops, flooring, tile, lighting, plumbing fixtures, hardware, appliances and more. Our designers accompany you to trusted suppliers, helping coordinate colors, textures and materials that fit both your style and your budget. Every selection is made with quality, durability and long-term value in mind.

04
Construction

Experienced craftsmen bring your design to life with precision.

A dedicated Project Manager oversees every phase of your renovation, keeping you informed while ensuring the project stays organized, efficient and on schedule. We respect your home by protecting surrounding areas, maintaining a clean worksite and minimizing disruption whenever possible. Throughout construction you'll receive regular updates, so you're always informed about the progress of your project.

05
Enjoy Your New Space

The best part of every project is seeing the finished result.

Before completion, a detailed review confirms every element meets quality standards and expectations. Our goal is simple: deliver a space you'll love for years to come. Whether it's a stunning new kitchen, a luxurious bathroom or a beautifully finished basement, we're proud to help homeowners transform the places where life happens.

DESIGN POLICY

ABOUT US

A family firm, building for families.

Founded in 2009 in Gaithersburg, Maryland, AC Remodeling is a family-owned design-build firm delivering fully integrated, high-investment remodels across Montgomery County and Northwest Washington, DC.

Request My Consultation
View Portfolio

Every project is planned, priced and built by one team, from the first sketch through construction, under a single contract. The same designers and builders stay involved throughout, so nothing gets lost between the drawing and the build.

The firm’s boutique size allows for owner-led, daily on-site oversight on every project. Alex Reyes manages construction quality in person, while Carolina Reyes and Melissa Rojas lead the design. That direct involvement keeps every kitchen, spa bathroom or finished basement held to the same standard of craftsmanship.

Request My Consultation

OUR STORY

A family-led approach to luxury remodeling.

Alex Reyes and his wife Carolina founded AC Remodeling in 2009 in Gaithersburg, Maryland. They built a boutique design-build model to prioritize craftsmanship and close client communication over high project volume. Based in Gaithersburg, MD, the firm remains rooted in the local community.

Alex and Carolina divide responsibilities to maintain quality control across every project phase:

Alex Reyes acts as project manager, maintaining a daily on-site presence to manage construction quality.
Carolina Reyes and Melissa Rojas guide design and accompany clients to vendor showrooms to select finishes.
Both owners remain directly accessible, giving clients a straight line of communication throughout the project.

Our company management keeps projects on schedule and makes sure your vision is executed as planned. Major home remodels raise real questions: will quality be consistent? Will decisions stay clear? Our founder-led model addresses each concern by removing middle management, where details often get lost.

OUR CORE TEAM

Founder-led, on site every day.

AC Remodeling is a family-owned design-build firm founded in Gaithersburg in 2009. No middle management — the owners run your project.

Alex Reyes

PRESIDENT & CEO

Licensed contractor and unabashed perfectionist. Alex is on site daily, holding construction quality, materials and detailing to his own standard.

“I pride myself on high-quality work, never cutting corners, and paying the utmost attention to details.”

Carolina Reyes

MANAGING DIRECTOR

Carolina leads design direction, joins every client meeting and translates your wish list into a plan our build team can deliver on budget.

“We are here for you. Our top priority is making your life easier through the whole project.”

Melissa Rojas

DESIGN ASSISTANT

Melissa guides you through selections and showroom visits, balancing beauty and function down to the last tile, fixture and finish.

“I am my happiest when creating a space that brings you joy.”

RECOGNITION

17 Houzz Awards 2014–2021 & 2024–2026.

Best of Houzz honors for both Design and Service, awarded by homeowners and the Houzz community across more than a decade of kitchen, bath and basement remodels in Montgomery County and Northwest Washington, DC.

View Our Houzz Profile

OUR DESIGN-BUILD SCOPE

Complete, single-contract remodels only.

We manage every detail from the initial 3D rendering to the final inspection. AC Remodeling does not take on minor repairs, handyman tasks or partial updates — our work is built for homeowners who want a single point of accountability.

Interior design

Complete culinary spaces, finished basements and private sanctuaries built for daily wellness — hand-selected stone, custom cabinetry, refined tilework, precision lighting and premium fixtures.

High-function living areas

Finished basements with custom wet bars, home theaters, family rooms, baths, offices or bedrooms and smart-home automation — adapted to Montgomery County's colonial, mid-century and 1960s–80s housing stock.

In-house permit administration

We manage all municipal approvals ourselves. Regular coordination with county and city permitting departments means compliant plans and approval timelines that keep your project moving.

ONE ROOF

Full design-build coordination.

Independent design firms often select materials without consulting the construction team, which is where unexpected cost increases begin. We bridge that gap by designing alongside the crews who build. Every phase is handled in-house:

01

Premium material selection

02

Permit management

03

Ordering materials

04

Construction

05

Final detailing and handoff

RECOGNITION

Verified local trust.

A successful high-investment remodel depends on verifiable performance, not promotional claims. Independent construction and design platforms confirm our quality through objective evaluation of our local operating history.

Better Business Bureau
Recognized as a BBB business with a clean regulatory record.
Best of Houzz Awards
Earned from 2014 through 2026 for design and service.
Verified five-star ratings
Maintained consistently across major third-party review platforms.
NKBA & EPA Lead-Safe
Certified design professionals and a Lead-Safe certified firm.
15+ Years Experience
Fifteen years of remodeling homes across Montgomery County and Northwest DC.
True Design Build
Design, engineering, permitting and construction under one accountable contract.
Dedicated Project Manager
One name, one number, one person responsible for your schedule.

CODES & STRUCTURE

Building codes and structural footprints in Montgomery County & DC.

Planning and permitting rules shape both your construction timeline and your design decisions. Our design-build process integrates regulatory compliance from day one to protect high-investment projects from delays.

Every neighborhood presents distinct structural realities. Reconfiguring mid-century layouts in Silver Spring or updating post-war ranches in Kensington takes a different approach than modifying grand colonials in Potomac or Chevy Chase. In Gaithersburg and Germantown, maximizing layout efficiency is key. We design for your specific housing stock so structural integrity and flow are both preserved.

FAQ

Frequently asked questions.
Who owns AC Remodeling, and is it family-owned?

Yes. AC Remodeling is a family-owned design-build firm founded in 2009 by husband-and-wife team Alejandro (Alex) and Carolina Reyes. Based in Gaithersburg, our boutique company specializes in high-end remodeling with active personal involvement from both owners. Alex leads on-site construction daily; Carolina guides design and material selections for a consistent client experience.

Is AC Remodeling a design-build firm or a general contractor?

We operate as a fully integrated design-build firm rather than a standard general contractor. Design, space planning and construction all happen under a single contract. By managing everything in-house, we eliminate communication gaps, keep timelines predictable, and make sure your design is practical for actual construction.

Do you work in Bethesda, Gaithersburg, Rockville, and Northwest Washington, DC?

Yes. Our primary service footprint covers all of Montgomery County, Maryland, and Northwest Washington, DC. We regularly manage complex home remodeling in Gaithersburg, Rockville, Bethesda, Potomac and Chevy Chase, and we are experienced in the specific permit regulations across these distinct municipal jurisdictions.

How do you keep design decisions aligned with the construction investment?

We keep your project budget on track through structured communication during the early planning stages. Carolina or Melissa guides you through local vendor showrooms to pick fixtures, finishes and tile that fit your aesthetic, so you can evaluate real-world material costs before physical construction begins.

What types of remodeling projects are the best fit for AC Remodeling?

Our services are built for complete, high-investment residential transformations: custom kitchens, primary suite sanctuaries, and finished basements with custom bars. We focus exclusively on full-scope remodels rather than partial updates or repair work.

Alex and his team are hands down the best contractors that we have ever hired. He remodeled our kitchen and it now looks like something out of a magazine. He is a perfectionist and it truly shows in the beautiful craftsmanship of his work. His crew showed up right on time every day and cleaned up very well at the end of every workday. Alex is excellent at communicating the progress each day and at keeping the project right on schedule. He also knows his products and will steer you in the right direction when selecting counters, backsplash, etc. He knows the latest technology to modernize your house, and wants to make sure you are 100 percent happy. We highly recommend them!

M. K.

KENTLANDS — GAITHERSBURG, MARYLAND

Alex, Carolina, and their team of expert kitchen installers did a fabulous job for us. We had a complete kitchen remodel including electrical and plumbing, and everything turned out beautifully. They were a joy to work with and completed the job on time and within budget. Very well organized, very professional, and very knowledgeable about materials and appliances. I highly recommend them!

L.A. L.

GAITHERSBURG, MARYLAND

We weren't planning to remodel our kitchen, but we had a major plumbing problem. It's certainly easy to give Alex and his crew at AC Remodeling a 5-star review for this project. Alex has many years of remodeling experience in our area and knows where to get the best materials to meet his customers' needs. He guides his customers through the many decisions needed for the project and takes pride in doing his job well. Alex is an outstanding project manager and leads a highly professional team. Every work day the team shows up at 8 AM and puts in a full day of work. They are very detailed in the work they do. We love the new kitchen. Alex: I am very glad we met you.

S. V.

BETHESDA, MARYLAND

Alex is a gem. He was a stranger at the outset and I feel he is a friend now. I wanted new counter tops and didn't have a clue how to proceed. Alex walked with me through the entire process. Perhaps the best thing he did was be honest. He never let me settle for something that would not give me complete satisfaction, from the stone to the new sink and faucet. He and his crew were so friendly and efficient that I found myself enjoying the process which I had been putting off for (literally) years. I am so totally satisfied with the end product. Having workmen in your house is usually a bother but Alex and his crew were quick, clean, on-time, cheerful and did a beautiful job. If I ever have another project like this, Alex will be my first choice.

L. P.

GERMANTOWN, MARYLAND

Alex and Carolina Reyes of AC Remodeling and their entire crew did an outstanding job completely renovating our 30-year-old kitchen. Their knowledge and expertise were evident in every way — from the excellent advice that Alex and Carolina provided, to the crew's punctuality and reliability, their skilled professional workmanship, their attention to details and their pride in their work. They also did a thorough cleanup at the end of each day. Alex orchestrated the project in such an amazing way that not a minute was wasted, and our beautiful kitchen was completed in only 20 work days, just as Alex had promised at the beginning of the project. It was a pleasure to work with every person associated with AC Remodeling. We recommend them highly.

A. M.

NORTH POTOMAC, MARYLAND

I am more than confident about sharing AC Remodeling's contact information with anyone who says they are worried, scared, or just plain confused about how to find a reputable and reliable remodeling contractor. One of the first things I look for in a business professional is a clear-cut and understandable plan that details how a company will work with a client from start to finish, and AC Remodeling met my expectations completely. The time estimates were very close, so no unpleasant surprises. We had some minor delays, but Alex kept me informed in a timely fashion so I could be prepared. The work team took great steps to prevent any damage to other areas of my home and cleaned up thoroughly each day so that living through a remodel was almost painless. I can with absolute sincerity recommend AC Remodeling.

S. R.

GAITHERSBURG, MARYLAND

I highly recommend Alex, Carolina, and their team. They are expertly skilled, detail oriented, and so very careful with your home and your project. The project plan is clear and detailed, the team is proficient, polite, and extremely skilled, and from top to bottom they are committed to making you happy. My bathroom is spectacular and the entire process was pleasant. My project was a major overhaul of an ensuite primary bath — a tiny walk-in closet and a tiny bathroom that we combined into a larger bathroom with a dressing area. Throughout the project, the carpet and stairs were covered, even when the workers were gone for the day. Every night the area was cleaned and packed up and the garbage removed. There were challenges, as there always are: the subfloor had to be replaced, as did the bottom of a few studs. Alex showed me the issues, clearly laid out the options, and let me choose. I feel happy and proud to add my own 5 stars to the reviews.

M.A. M.

NORTH POTOMAC, MARYLAND

Home Remodeling in
Gaithersburg, MD

AC Remodeling is headquartered in Gaithersburg, which means our crews and project managers are minutes from your driveway. We remodel everything from Kentlands colonials to newer Quince Orchard builds.

Request My Consultation

CLIENT REVIEWS

Our clients say it best — beautiful homes, built to perfection.

REMODELING IN GAITHERSBURG

What a Gaithersburg project looks like.

Because our office and shop are here, Gaithersburg projects get the shortest lines of communication we can offer. Deliveries stage locally, the project manager stops by between other visits, and a question raised in the morning usually has an answer the same day rather than the same week.

Most of the work we do here falls into three groups: kitchens that need a full layout change rather than new doors on old boxes, primary and hall bathrooms taken back to the studs, and unfinished basements built out with a family room, a bar and a full bath. Townhome kitchens in Kentlands and Lakelands often involve relocating plumbing and rebuilding a peninsula into a working island, while the larger detached homes closer to Quince Orchard tend toward opening the kitchen to the family room.

Every project runs on drawings, a detailed scope and one accountable team from first sketch through final detailing. Permits are filed with Montgomery County DPS and, where the property sits inside city limits, with the City of Gaithersburg.

GAITHERSBURG SCOPE

Kitchens, baths and basements in Gaithersburg.
Kitchen Remodeling in Gaithersburg

Kentlands and Lakelands townhome kitchens usually start as a galley with a peninsula that blocks the only path through the room. The fix is a full layout change: relocate the sink and gas line, rebuild the peninsula as a working island with seating on one side, and take cabinetry to the ceiling to recover the storage lost to appliance panels.

See how our kitchen remodeling process works
Bathroom Remodeling in Gaithersburg

Hall baths in Washingtonian Woods and Quince Orchard tend to be tub-only with a single small window. We take them to the studs, waterproof the full wet wall to manufacturer spec, and rebuild with slab-look porcelain, a recessed niche and layered lighting so a five-by-eight room stops feeling like a closet.

See how our bathroom remodeling process works
Basement Remodeling in Gaithersburg

Because our shop is minutes away, basement builds here stage materials locally and keep dust and traffic out of the rest of the house. A typical scope is a family room, a bar wall, a guest bedroom with proper egress and a full bath, permitted through Montgomery County DPS.

See how our basement remodeling process works

Home Remodeling in
Rockville, MD

Rockville's housing stock is exceptionally varied, from post-war ramblers in Twinbrook to larger colonials in Potomac Woods. Most of our Rockville work involves opening compartmentalized floor plans, modernizing systems and finishing basements.

Request My Consultation
View Portfolio

CLIENT REVIEWS

Our clients say it best — beautiful homes, built to perfection.

REMODELING IN ROCKVILLE

What a Rockville project looks like.

The recurring problem in Rockville is a floor plan drawn for the way families lived decades ago: a kitchen closed off behind a wall, a formal dining room nobody eats in, and a basement that stores boxes. Our design work usually starts by testing whether one or two walls can come out, and what that means structurally, before any finish is chosen.

Ramblers and split-levels also tend to bring original plumbing, undersized electrical service and duct runs in awkward places. Those are addressed during design rather than discovered mid-construction, and the beam, columns and footings needed to carry a removed wall are drawn by a structural engineer and written into the scope.

Alongside kitchens, we build a steady stream of Rockville primary baths and finished basements with bedrooms and full baths that meet egress and code requirements. Everything is permitted through Montgomery County DPS and inspected as the work progresses.

ROCKVILLE SCOPE

Kitchens, baths and basements in Rockville.
Kitchen Remodeling in Rockville

Twinbrook ramblers and Potomac Woods colonials share the same problem: a kitchen walled off from where the family actually sits. We test which walls can come out during design, have the beam, columns and footings drawn by a structural engineer, and lay the room out around one island rather than a peninsula.

See how our kitchen remodeling process works
Bathroom Remodeling in Rockville

Primary baths in mid-century Rockville homes are often two small original rooms and a hallway closet. Combining them gives room for a double vanity, a low-threshold shower with frameless glass and a private water closet, with old supply lines and undersized circuits replaced while the walls are open.

See how our bathroom remodeling process works
Basement Remodeling in Rockville

King Farm and Fallsmead basements are frequently built out as a legal bedroom with egress, a full bath and a family room. Duct runs get rerouted where they cost ceiling height, and plumbing inspection is closed out before the building inspection, which is how Montgomery County sequences it.

See how our basement remodeling process works

Bethesda homeowners expect a level of finish that leaves no margin for error. Our Bethesda projects lean toward custom cabinetry, natural stone and careful integration with existing plaster and trim profiles.

CLIENT REVIEWS

Our clients say it best — beautiful homes, built to perfection.

REMODELING IN BETHESDA

What a Bethesda project looks like.

Older Bethesda homes rarely give you flat walls, square corners or plumb openings. Fitting custom cabinetry into that reality is a measuring and scribing exercise, not a catalogue order, which is why our cabinetry is custom or semi-custom with full-overlay, soft-close construction and finishes chosen to sit beside existing woodwork rather than fight it.

Kitchens here often involve reworking a rear addition, relocating a powder room or rebuilding a butler's pantry, and primary suites frequently mean borrowing space from a hallway or an under-used bedroom. Both depend on drawings and a 3D design that let you see the room before demolition starts.

Bethesda also carries real permitting complexity. Projects go through Montgomery County DPS, and in the designated historic districts we handle historic area work permits and coordinate with the Historic Preservation Commission as part of the schedule rather than as an afterthought.

BETHESDA SCOPE

Kitchens, baths and basements in Bethesda.
Kitchen Remodeling in Bethesda

Older Edgemoor and Bradley Hills homes rarely give you square corners, so cabinetry here is custom or semi-custom and scribed to the room. Kitchens often involve reworking a rear addition or rebuilding a butler's pantry, with finishes chosen to sit beside existing plaster and original trim rather than fight it.

See how our kitchen remodeling process works
Bathroom Remodeling in Bethesda

Primary suites in Kenwood and Glen Echo Heights usually mean borrowing space from a hallway or an under-used bedroom. We draw it in 3D first, then build with certified waterproofing, laser-leveled large-format tile and lighting detailed the way a hotel suite is, including historic review where the district requires it.

See how our bathroom remodeling process works
Basement Remodeling in Bethesda

Bethesda lower levels come with stone foundations, low headroom and mechanical rooms in the wrong place. Every project starts with a diagnostic of the foundation walls and drainage; waterproofing goes to a trusted specialist, and we design and build the finished space around what that work requires.

CHEVY CHASE, MD
Home Remodeling in
Chevy Chase, MD

Chevy Chase remodels are about balance: bringing systems up to today's standards, opening the rear of the house to light and preserving the character of the front brick facade, all achieved through careful drawings, not guesswork.

Request My Consultation
View Portfolio

CLIENT REVIEWS

Our clients say it best — beautiful homes, built to perfection.

REMODELING IN CHEVY CHASE

What a Chevy Chase project looks like.

The houses in Chevy Chase Village, Somerset and Martin's Additions were built to be looked at from the street, and most owners want that left alone. The work happens behind and inside: a rear wall opened to the garden, a kitchen and mudroom reorganized, a primary bath carved out of small original rooms.

Behind the plaster, these homes usually need attention that has nothing to do with design taste, including old supply lines, limited electrical capacity and insulation that never existed. Sorting that out during design is what keeps a finished room from being beautiful and uncomfortable.

Original doors, hardware and trim are documented and salvaged during demolition and reinstalled or replicated where the drawings call for it. Permitting runs through Montgomery County DPS, with historic review coordinated where the property requires it.

CHEVY CHASE SCOPE

Kitchens, baths and basements in Chevy Chase.
Kitchen Remodeling in Chevy Chase

In Chevy Chase Village and Somerset the front facade stays untouched and the work happens behind it: the rear wall opened to the garden, the kitchen and mudroom reorganized, original doors and hardware salvaged during demolition and reinstalled where the drawings call for them.

See how our kitchen remodeling process works
Bathroom Remodeling in Chevy Chase

Carving a primary bath out of small original rooms is the most common request in Martin's Additions and Rollingwood. Along with the visible work, aging supply lines, limited circuits and missing insulation get addressed while the walls are open, so the finished room is comfortable as well as beautiful.

See how our bathroom remodeling process works
Basement Remodeling in Chevy Chase

Lower levels in these houses are usually short on height and long on mechanicals. We reroute ductwork, use slim-profile equipment to reclaim inches, and finish the space with sound-insulated walls and dedicated HVAC zoning so it feels like the floors above.

See how our basement remodeling process works

CHICAGO DESIGN-BUILD SINCE 2013
One Company.
Everything Included.

Assembly Squad is Chicago's boutique design-build general contractor — one licensed team handles every step of your renovation under one roof, one contract, one fixed price.

Most homeowners spend weeks coordinating between an architect, a designer, a general contractor, and a cabinet vendor — each one pointing fingers when things go wrong. We built Assembly Squad to eliminate that entirely. From the first design consultation at our Lincoln Park studio through the final city inspection, you work with one dedicated team and one project manager accountable for everything.

We specialize in kitchen remodeling, bathroom renovation, condo gut renovations, basement finishing, whole-home renovations, attic conversions, and Illinois-made custom cabinetry — serving all Chicago neighborhoods and the North Shore.

View our completed project portfolio, explore our full range of services, or see our Chicago service areas.

OUR STORY
Built in Chicago. Built Different.

From a two-person startup to Chicago's most trusted design-build company — here's how we got here.

2011
The Idea Begins

Viktor Aharon — 22+ years deep in remodeling — builds the first version of Assembly Squad as a mobile app designed to help homeowners navigate the remodeling process more intelligently, giving them a smarter way to plan, budget, and manage their renovation.

2013
Assembly Squad Is Born

The app evolves into something bigger. Assembly Squad officially launches as a boutique design-build general contracting company — IL License #TGC098779, HQ at 205 N Michigan Ave. One team, one contract, one stress-free experience.

2015
Condo Expertise Takes Shape

As Chicago's high-rise condo renovation demand surges, Assembly Squad builds its HOA coordination system — alteration agreements, COI management, board presentations. Pre-approvals begin accumulating. Today that number exceeds 300 buildings.

2019
Recognition & Growth

Assembly Squad earns Best of Houzz, joins NKBA, and achieves its A+ BBB rating. The team completes its 200th Chicago renovation. Specialization deepens across kitchen design-build, historic greystone renovation, and luxury condo gut rehabs.

2024
Illinois-Made Cabinets

Assembly Squad launches its Illinois-made custom cabinetry program — cutting import delays from 16 weeks to 4–6. Better cabinets, faster delivery, zero tariff exposure. No overseas supply chain risk.

2025
Lincoln Park Design Studio Opens

Assembly Squad opens its 2,500 sq ft design-build studio at 2315 N Southport Ave, Lincoln Park. With 500+ curated materials on display — cabinet finishes, countertop slabs, tile, hardware, and flooring — clients work side by side with our experienced design team before a single wall comes down.

2025
Squad to Suburbs

Assembly Squad launches its North Shore expansion — bringing the same boutique design-build experience to Winnetka, Lake Forest, Highland Park, Glencoe, Evanston, and beyond.

TODAY
500+ Projects. Still Building.

13+ years. 500+ completed renovations. 4.9 stars. A+ BBB. NARI Chicago member. EPA Lead-Safe Certified. And the same commitment Viktor started with in 2011 — make Chicago home renovation the way it should always have been: stress-free, transparent, and built to last.

OUR EXPERTISE
Why Chicago Homeowners Choose Assembly Squad

Licensed professionals with specialized expertise in Chicago's unique architectural challenges.

Historic Preservation Specialists

EPA Lead-Safe Certified Firm (#NAT-F285417-1) specializing in 1880s–1920s Chicago architecture. We preserve original character while updating plumbing, electrical, and structural systems. Certified under the EPA Renovation, Repair & Painting program — required for work in pre-1978 Chicago homes including greystones and bungalows.

Chicago Permit Experts

All permits and inspections included on every project. Licensed contractor (IL #TGC098779) with direct experience navigating city inspectors across all Chicago neighborhoods. Typical permit processing: 2–3 weeks, factored into every project timeline.

Condo & HOA Specialists

Pre-approved in 300+ Chicago buildings. We navigate HOA alteration agreements, elevator scheduling, insurance certificates, and building management protocols on every condo project. 75% of our completed projects are Chicago condominium renovations. Zero HOA complaints in 13 years.

NKBA & NARI Certified

Certified by the National Kitchen & Bath Association and a member of NARI of Greater Chicagoland. Our designers follow industry best practices for space planning, material selection, and code compliance. View our NKBA profile and NARI Chicago listing.

Viktor Aharon
Founder & CEO
Assembly Squad Remodeling
22+ years in remodeling
FROM THE FOUNDER
Why I Started Assembly Squad

"I wanted to build something genuinely different — a company where Chicago homeowners never have to waste a single hour of their day managing their own renovation."

After more than 22 years working in remodeling, I saw the same frustrations play out over and over. Homeowners juggling multiple contractors, chasing permit updates, making a dozen decisions no one prepared them for — all while trying to live their lives. The process was broken, and it didn't have to be.

Assembly Squad started as an app in 2011 — built specifically to help homeowners navigate the remodeling process more intelligently. By 2013, that idea evolved into a boutique design-build general contracting company built around a single principle. One team handles everything. Design, permits, materials, construction, and final walkthrough — under one contract, one fixed price, one dedicated project manager.

What sets us apart isn't just what we build — it's how we think about why you're building it. Some clients are creating a forever home. Others are planning a 5 to 6 year stay before moving on. Both are valid, and both deserve a smart renovation strategy. We build a plan that balances your enjoyment of the home today with the return you'll see when it's time to sell. You shouldn't have to choose between loving where you live now and protecting your investment later.

That's the company I set out to build in 2013. That's the company we are today.

"Thirteen years in this industry has taught me one thing above everything else — transparency, fairness, and genuinely putting your clients first isn't just the right way to do business. It's the only reason any business lasts."

FAQ
Frequently Asked Questions

Common questions about Assembly Squad's credentials, process, and locations.

What makes Assembly Squad different from other Chicago remodeling contractors?
Assembly Squad is a true design-build company — one team handles design, permits, materials, construction, and final walkthrough under a single fixed-price contract. Founded by Viktor Aharon after 22+ years in remodeling, specifically to solve the coordination and stress problems that plague most Chicago renovations. One dedicated project manager, zero change orders, 2-year workmanship warranty on every project. IL License #TGC098779, A+ BBB, NARI Chicago member.
Is Assembly Squad licensed and insured in Illinois?
Yes. IL General Contractor License #TGC098779, $2M liability insurance, A+ BBB. Also an EPA Lead-Safe Certified Firm (#NAT-F285417-1), NKBA member, and NARI of Greater Chicagoland member.
Does Assembly Squad handle HOA approvals for condo remodeling?
Yes — HOA coordination is fully included on every condo project. Pre-approved in 300+ Chicago buildings. We handle alteration agreements, COI, architectural drawings, neighbor notifications, and board presentations. 75% of our projects are condo renovations. Zero HOA complaints in 13 years. Call (312) 544-9150.
Is Assembly Squad EPA Lead-Safe Certified?
Yes — EPA Lead-Safe Certified Firm, Certification #NAT-F285417-1 under the EPA Renovation, Repair & Painting program. Required for work in pre-1978 homes — directly relevant for Chicago's greystones, bungalows, and vintage two-flats.
Where is the Assembly Squad design studio?
2315 N Southport Ave, Lincoln Park, Chicago IL 60614 — open Mon–Fri 9am–6pm, Sat 10am–4pm, by appointment. 2,500 sq ft showroom with 500+ curated materials — cabinet finishes, countertop slabs, tile, hardware, and flooring — all selected alongside our design team. Free 3D renderings included. HQ at 205 N Michigan Ave, Suite 810. Call (312) 544-9150.
How long has Assembly Squad been in business?
Founded by Viktor Aharon in 2013 — 13+ years in Chicago. 500+ completed projects. 4.9-star Google rating. A+ BBB throughout. Viktor brought 22+ years of remodeling expertise to the company's founding. Assembly Squad originated as an app in 2011 before evolving into a full design-build general contracting firm in 2013.

Services
WELCOME TO ASSEMBLY SQUAD
Chicago's Full-Service Design-Build Remodeling Company

Since 2013, Assembly Squad Remodeling has been transforming homes across Chicago, the North Shore, and surrounding suburbs. As a licensed general contractor, we handle every aspect of your renovation — from initial design concepts through final construction — so you have one trusted team managing your entire project.

Design Studio
Lincoln Park Showroom
HOW WE WORK
Our 4-Step Process

Every project follows the same proven approach — from your first call to final walkthrough.

01
FREE & NO OBLIGATION
Consultation

We visit your home, discuss your vision, assess the space, and answer all your questions.

02
FIXED-PRICE QUOTE
Design & Proposal

Custom plans with 3D renderings and detailed line-item pricing. No hidden fees.

03
DAILY UPDATES
Construction

Your dedicated project manager keeps everything on track with daily updates.

04
2-YEAR WARRANTY
Completion

Final walkthrough, touch-ups, and your 2-year workmanship warranty.

OUR EXPERTISE
Chicago Home Remodeling Services
MOST POPULAR
Kitchen Remodeling

After remodeling hundreds of Chicago kitchens, we've learned that no two projects are alike. Whether you're working with a galley kitchen in a vintage two-flat or opening up walls in a Lincoln Park brownstone, we design around how you actually cook and live.

Custom cabinetry solutions
Vintage building expertise
Chicago permit handling
Full design-build service
Learn more about kitchen remodeling
HIGH ROI
Bathroom Remodeling

Chicago bathrooms are notoriously small — we get it. Over the years, we've developed real solutions for maximizing tight spaces without sacrificing style. From tub-to-shower conversions to full gut renovations.

Tub-to-shower conversions
Older plumbing expertise
Space-maximizing layouts
All-inclusive pricing
Learn more about bathroom remodeling
ADDED SPACE
Basement Finishing

Finishing a basement in Chicago means dealing with moisture — there's no way around it. We start every project with a thorough assessment and address any water issues before building out walls. Basement remodeling in Chicago runs $55–$140 per square foot, and under the city's new ADU ordinance we can even convert your basement into a legal rental apartment.

Moisture assessment included
Low ceiling solutions
Egress window installation
Basement ADU conversions
Learn more about basement finishing
URBAN LIVING
Condo Remodeling

Renovating a condo in Chicago is a different animal than working on a single-family home. We've worked in buildings throughout the Gold Coast, Streeterville, and River North, so we know the drill.

HOA paperwork handled
Building coordination
High-rise experience
Neighbor-friendly scheduling
Learn more about condo remodeling
COMPLETE
Whole Home Renovation

When you're updating multiple rooms or doing a full gut renovation, having one contractor manage everything makes a real difference. We coordinate all the trades — electrical, plumbing, HVAC, carpentry.

Single point of contact
All trades coordinated
Older home expertise
Detailed project timeline
Learn more about whole home renovation
MADE IN IL
Custom Cabinets

We partner with cabinet manufacturers right here in Illinois, which means shorter lead times and no import tariffs affecting your price. Show us any photo and we can build it.

Made in Illinois
4-6 week lead time
Free 3D renderings
Any style, any room
Learn more about custom cabinets
ADU READY
Attic Conversions

Chicago's bungalows and two-flats often have attics with real potential. We've converted dozens into bedrooms, home offices, playrooms, and legal ADUs that generate rental income.

ADU permit expertise
Structural assessment
Climate-rated insulation
Code-compliant design
Learn more about attic conversions
BUDGET-FRIENDLY
IKEA Kitchen Installation

We've been installing IKEA kitchens since 2013, and honestly, they're a smart choice for many homeowners. The cabinet boxes are solid, and with the right installation, they look custom.

IKEA planning help
Custom panel options
Modification expertise
Professional installation
Learn more about IKEA kitchen installation
VISIT US
Design-Build Showroom

Our 2,500 sq ft Lincoln Park showroom is where your renovation begins. Touch real materials, see full-size cabinet displays, and work with our design team to create 3D renderings of your project — all before construction starts.

Full-size cabinet displays
Countertop & tile samples
Free 3D design renderings
One team: design + build

FREQUENTLY ASKED
Questions about Chicago remodeling

Expert answers about our Chicago kitchen and bathroom remodeling services, costs, timelines, and process.

How much does kitchen remodeling cost in Chicago in 2026?
Kitchen remodeling costs in Chicago for 2026 range from $25,000 to $250,000+ depending on size, materials, and scope. Budget IKEA kitchens start at $15,000–$35,000 (2–3 weeks). Mid-range custom kitchens cost $40,000–$80,000 (4–6 weeks). Luxury custom kitchens with premium finishes range $100,000–$250,000+ (6–12 weeks). Assembly Squad provides transparent itemized pricing with no hidden fees. See our full kitchen remodel cost guide →
How long does a complete home remodel take in Chicago?
Complete whole-home remodels in Chicago typically take 10–16 weeks depending on scope. Kitchen-only remodels: 3–6 weeks. Single bathroom remodels: 2–4 weeks. Multiple-room renovations (kitchen plus 2 bathrooms): 8–12 weeks. Whole-home transformations with structural changes: 12–16 weeks. Our recent Wicker Park whole-home project at 1654 N Oakley completed in 12 weeks — kitchen, 3 bathrooms, entertainment built-ins, hardwood refinishing throughout.
What Chicago neighborhoods does Assembly Squad serve?
Assembly Squad serves all Chicago neighborhoods and North Shore suburbs — Lincoln Park, Gold Coast, Wicker Park, Bucktown, West Loop, River North, Streeterville, Lakeview, Lakeshore East, South Loop, Old Town, Logan Square, Uptown, Andersonville, Hyde Park, West Town, North Park, Little Italy, plus Evanston, Winnetka, Lake Forest, Hinsdale, Highland Park, and Flossmoor. City of Chicago licensed general contractor (TGC098779) serving the Chicago area since 2013 with 500+ completed projects.
Do you remodel Chicago lofts — West Loop, River North, Fulton Market?
Yes — loft remodeling is a specialty for Assembly Squad. We handle warehouse conversion lofts in West Loop and Fulton Market, high-rise open-plan condos in River North and Streeterville, artist lofts in Wicker Park and Bucktown, and adaptive-reuse buildings in Uptown. Loft-specific expertise includes exposed brick kitchen backsplash integration, steel column design work, open ceiling HVAC coordination, and high-ceiling lighting design. See our full Chicago loft remodeling service page →
Does Assembly Squad work on Gold Coast pre-war co-ops and Lake Shore Drive buildings?
Yes — Gold Coast pre-war co-op and Lake Shore Drive renovations are a specialty. Recent work includes the full renovation of a 1929 Robert DeGolyer pre-war co-op at 1242 N Lake Shore Drive, kitchen and bath at 1010 N Lake Shore Drive, and bathroom renovation at 680 N Lake Shore Drive. Direct experience with co-op board approvals, alteration agreements, and preservation of original architectural details.
Does Assembly Squad offer free estimates for Chicago remodeling?
Yes — free in-home consultations and detailed estimates for all kitchen, bathroom, and whole-home remodeling projects throughout Chicago. Estimates include itemized materials cost, labor breakdown, timeline with milestones, permit costs, and 3D design renderings for projects over $40K. Call (312) 544‑9150 or visit our Lincoln Park design studio at 2315 N Southport Ave.
Do you handle permits for Chicago remodeling projects?
Yes — all permits and inspections handled on every project. Assembly Squad manages all permit applications, coordinates electrical, plumbing, and structural inspections, and makes sure the work meets the Chicago Building Code. Review times depend on the permit type, so we submit early and let permits run alongside design and cabinet production. Permit costs are included in our fixed-price proposals.
Does Assembly Squad handle HOA approvals for condo remodeling?
Yes — condo and HOA approvals are handled on every condo project. We prepare alteration agreements, certificates of insurance, architectural drawings and board presentations, and schedule freight elevators with building management. All HOA coordination costs are included in our fixed-price proposals.
Is Assembly Squad licensed and insured in Illinois?
Yes. City of Chicago General Contractor License #TGC098779, fully insured, A+ BBB. Also an EPA Lead-Safe Certified Firm (#NAT-F285417-1), NKBA member, and NARI of Greater Chicagoland member. Founded 2013. 13+ years, 500+ completed projects.

Where Does Assembly Squad Remodel?

Assembly Squad Remodeling is a Chicago design-build contractor serving 15 Chicago neighborhoods, 9 North Shore communities and 8 suburbs within about 40 miles of the Loop. Typical budgets run $25,000 to $150,000+ for kitchens, $15,000 to $55,000 for bathrooms, $85,000 to $300,000+ for condo gut renovations and $30,000 to $100,000+ for basements. Every area gets the same free in-home consultation, fixed-price proposal and 2-year workmanship warranty.

Why Chicago Homeowners Choose Assembly Squad

Assembly Squad is a genuine local company, not a national chain with a Chicago phone number. Since 2013 we've built deep knowledge of Chicago's permit offices, building managers, and the architectural quirks that make each community unique.

One team from design through construction. One fixed-price contract, one project manager, one 2-year warranty. We specialize in kitchen remodeling, bathroom renovation, condo gut renovations, basement finishing, whole house remodeling, attic conversions, and Illinois-made custom cabinetry.

Expanding to the North Shore? Our North Shore remodeling hub covers Winnetka, Lake Forest, Highland Park, and beyond. Visit our Lincoln Park design studio or see our completed project portfolio.

FAQ
Service Area FAQs

Common questions about Assembly Squad's service areas across Chicago and suburbs.

Which Chicago neighborhoods does Assembly Squad serve?
Assembly Squad serves 15 Chicago neighborhoods with dedicated service pages. North Side coverage includes Lincoln Park, Lakeview, Roscoe Village, Andersonville and Lake Shore Drive. Downtown covers Gold Coast, River North, Streeterville, The Loop, Old Town and South Loop. West and Northwest Chicago covers West Loop, Logan Square, Wicker Park and Bucktown.
Does Assembly Squad serve North Shore communities like Winnetka and Lake Forest?
Yes. Through its Squad to Suburbs 2026 initiative, Assembly Squad serves nine North Shore communities: Winnetka, Lake Forest, Highland Park, Glencoe, Wilmette, Evanston, Kenilworth, Lake Bluff and Northbrook. Each has a dedicated service page, and North Shore consultations start with an in-home visit or at the Lincoln Park design studio at 2315 N Southport Ave.
Which Chicago suburbs does Assembly Squad serve?
Beyond the North Shore, Assembly Squad serves Arlington Heights, Barrington Hills, South Barrington, Buffalo Grove, Hinsdale, Inverness, Lincolnshire and Glenview. Suburban projects include kitchens, bathrooms, basements and whole-home renovations. Homeowners in other Chicagoland suburbs can call (312) 544-9150 to confirm whether their address falls inside the service area.
How far from Chicago does Assembly Squad work?
Assembly Squad works within roughly 40 miles of the Chicago Loop. That radius reaches north to Lake Forest and Lake Bluff, northwest to Barrington Hills and Inverness, and west to Hinsdale. Every project inside the radius gets the same free in-home consultation, fixed-price proposal and 2-year workmanship warranty as a Chicago project.
Is Assembly Squad a licensed remodeling contractor?
Yes. Assembly Squad Remodeling LLC holds City of Chicago General Contractor License #TGC098779, carries $2M liability insurance, holds an A+ BBB rating and is a NARI of Greater Chicagoland member. Illinois has no statewide general contractor license, so suburban projects are permitted through each village's own building department.
Does Assembly Squad handle HOA and condo building approvals in Chicago?
Yes. Assembly Squad is pre-approved in 300+ Chicago condo buildings and manages the full HOA process on every project, including alteration agreements, certificates of insurance, architectural drawings, neighbor notifications and board presentations. Freight elevator scheduling and building manager coordination are handled by the Assembly Squad team, so owners are not chasing paperwork.
How do I get a remodeling estimate in my area?
Call (312) 544-9150 or request a free in-home consultation online. Assembly Squad visits homes anywhere in Chicago, the North Shore and the listed suburbs, then delivers a fixed-price proposal within 48 hours. Homeowners can also compare finishes and full-size cabinet displays at the Lincoln Park design studio, open by appointment.

Frequently Asked Questions About Chicago Home Remodeling
What makes a good home remodeling blog in Chicago?
+
A good Chicago home remodeling blog should provide local expertise, actual project costs specific to Chicago, neighborhood-specific advice, permit guidance, and insights from experienced local contractors. Assembly Squad's blog offers all this with 500+ completed Chicago projects worth of real experience.
How much does home remodeling cost in Chicago?
+
Chicago home remodeling costs vary by neighborhood and project scope. Kitchen remodels range from $25,000-$100,000+, bathroom renovations from $15,000-$50,000+, and whole-home remodels from $100,000-$500,000+. Costs are typically 15-25% higher than national averages due to Chicago's permitting requirements and skilled labor costs.
Do I need permits for home remodeling in Chicago?
+
Yes, most home remodeling projects in Chicago require permits from the Department of Buildings. This includes kitchen renovations, bathroom remodels, electrical work, plumbing changes, and structural modifications. Processing typically takes 6-10 weeks and costs vary by project scope.
What neighborhoods does Assembly Squad serve in Chicago?
+
Assembly Squad serves all Chicago neighborhoods including Lincoln Park, Lakeview, Logan Square, Wicker Park, Bucktown, River North, Gold Coast, West Loop, Hyde Park, Streeterville, and 40+ other areas throughout the city and nearby suburbs.
How do I choose the best Chicago home remodeling blog?
+
Look for blogs from established Chicago contractors with real project experience, actual cost information, permit guidance, neighborhood-specific advice, and before/after examples. Assembly Squad's blog combines 12+ years of Chicago experience with insights from 500+ completed projects across the city's diverse neighborhoods.

Assembly Squad is different — we're a true Chicago design-build firm and licensed kitchen remodeling contractor Chicago homeowners have trusted since 2013 — with in-house designers, dedicated crews, and deep experience in Gold Coast high-rises, Wicker Park three-flats, Lincoln Park greystones, and everything in between.

We know Chicago buildings. We know Chicago permits. And our Illinois-made custom kitchen cabinets ship in 4–6 weeks with zero import tariffs — while other Chicago kitchen remodeling companies wait 12–16 weeks for overseas orders that cost you more every month tariffs climb. 13 Years. 300+ Buildings.
Every Chicago Condo — High-Rise, Greystone & Beyond.

When you search "condo remodeling Chicago" you'll find general contractors who've never navigated a Chicago HOA board, never coordinated a freight elevator, and never dealt with a greystone's galvanized plumbing stack. Assembly Squad is different — we're a true Chicago design-build firm and licensed condo remodeling contractor Chicago owners have trusted since 2013 — with in-house designers, dedicated crews, and deep experience in Gold Coast luxury towers, River North lofts, Lincoln Park greystone conversions, and everything in between.

We know Chicago buildings. We know Chicago HOA boards. And our Illinois-made custom cabinetry ships in 4–6 weeks with zero import tariffs — while other condo renovation companies wait 12–16 weeks for overseas orders that cost you more every month tariffs climb. Our design-build condo Chicago process means one team handles everything: HOA approvals, permits, construction, and final walkthrough.

"We've been inside 300+ Chicago buildings — we know the freight elevator schedule at Marina City, the HOA board at 1 East Delaware, and what it takes to get a permit approved fast at the Department of Buildings. That institutional knowledge is what separates a smooth condo renovation from a nightmare. I built Assembly Squad to be the contractor I'd hire for my own Chicago home."

— VIKTOR AHARON, FOUNDER & CEO, ASSEMBLY SQUAD REMODELING (EST. 2013)

COMMON QUESTIONS
Chicago Condo Remodeling FAQ
How much does condo remodeling cost in Chicago in 2026?
Chicago condo remodeling costs range from $25K–$50K for a kitchen refresh, $50K–$120K for kitchen + primary bathroom, and $100K–$300K+ for a full gut renovation. Costs vary by neighborhood — Gold Coast and River North luxury towers typically run 20–40% higher than Lakeview or South Loop condos. See our complete Chicago condo cost guide 2026 for detailed neighborhood breakdowns.
Do I need HOA approval to remodel my Chicago condo?
Yes — virtually all Chicago condo buildings require HOA or board approval before work begins. This typically includes architectural plans, contractor insurance certificates, an alteration agreement, and sometimes a full board presentation. We handle the entire HOA approval process on every project — you don't deal with the board or management company at all. We're pre-approved in 300+ Chicago buildings. See our complete 2026 condo renovation permission guide for the full HOA and city permit process.
How long does a Chicago condo renovation take?
Construction takes 3–14 weeks depending on scope: bathrooms 3–5 weeks, kitchens 4–8 weeks, full gut renovations 10–14 weeks. Add 2–4 weeks for HOA approval prior to start. Chicago Standard Plan Review runs 7–9 weeks — we submit permits on day one so they run concurrently with design and material orders.
What makes Assembly Squad different from other Chicago condo contractors?
Three things nobody else offers: (1) Pre-approved in 300+ buildings — we know the management companies, HOA boards, and building-specific rules before we set foot in your unit. (2) Fixed-price packages — no change orders, no surprises after you sign. (3) A Lincoln Park design studio at 2315 N Southport where you see and touch every cabinet, countertop, and tile before we build. 13 years local, A+ BBB, 500+ projects completed.
Can you remodel a high-rise condo in Chicago?
Yes — high-rise condo remodeling is one of our specialties. We've completed projects in buildings up to 60+ floors across Streeterville, Gold Coast, and River North. We coordinate freight elevators, follow restricted construction hours (typically 8am–5pm weekdays), manage material deliveries, and maintain clean common areas throughout construction.
Can you remodel a greystone or vintage Chicago condo?
Yes — greystone condo and vintage building renovations are a specialty. Lincoln Park greystones, Lakeview 3-flats, and pre-war vintage condos have unique challenges: older galvanized plumbing, knob-and-tube electrical, and narrow stairways for material delivery. We scope all of this in your free consultation so there are zero surprises mid-project.
Do you handle Chicago building permits for condo renovations?
Yes — we handle all permit applications through the City of Chicago Department of Buildings. Most condo kitchen and bathroom renovations require permits for plumbing, electrical, and structural changes. We submit applications, schedule all required inspections, and ensure all work is 100% code-compliant. Permit costs are included in your project estimate.
Does a Chicago condo remodel increase home value?
Yes — Chicago condo renovations return 75–85% ROI in increased home value. Gold Coast, River North, and Lincoln Park condos see the highest returns. A full kitchen + bathroom renovation in a high-rise can add $80K–$150K+ to your resale price depending on the building and finishes.
Can I stay in my condo during the renovation?
Yes — the majority of our condo clients stay in their unit. We set up dust barriers, work within building hours, and keep common areas clean throughout. We recommend staying elsewhere only during demolition (typically days 1–3). For full gut renovations, we work with you to plan a realistic temporary living arrangement if needed.

CHICAGO BASEMENT FAQS
Common Questions Answered

Everything you need to know about basement remodeling in Chicago.

How much does basement remodeling cost in Chicago in 2026?
Chicago basement remodeling typically costs $55-140 per square foot. A 600 sq ft basement costs $35,000-$55,000 for basic finishing, $55,000-$95,000 with bathroom and egress window, and $95,000-$150,000+ for luxury finishes. Chicago costs trend 10-15% higher than national averages.
Can I convert my basement into a rental apartment (ADU) in Chicago?
Yes — under Chicago's citywide ADU ordinance, permit applications opened April 1, 2026, and buildings at least 20 years old in eligible zoning districts can add one basement conversion unit for long-term rental. A basement ADU conversion typically costs $65,000–$120,000 including kitchenette, bathroom, egress, and waterproofing. We handle zoning checks, permits, and construction.
How much does a basement bathroom installation cost in Chicago?
A basement bathroom installation in Chicago typically runs $18,000–$35,000 as an add-on to your overall basement finish, depending on plumbing distance from existing lines and finish level. It includes rough-in plumbing, a shower or tub, tile, and ventilation.
Do you install wet bars as part of a basement remodel?
Yes — a wet bar and entertainment area is one of our most requested basement add-ons, running $12,000–$28,000 on top of the base finish depending on cabinetry, appliances, and tile work. It's designed and built alongside your full basement remodel by one team, not a separate contractor.
Do I need a permit to finish my basement in Chicago?
Yes—Chicago requires building permits for all basement finishing work. Permit costs range from $1,000-$3,000 and take 2-5 weeks to process. We handle all permit applications, drawings, and inspections.
What are Chicago's basement bedroom requirements?
You need an egress window with minimum 5.7 sq ft opening, minimum 20" width and 24" height, maximum 44" sill height, and a window well at least 36" wide if below grade. Installation costs $3,000-$7,000.
How do you handle waterproofing?
We assess every basement and typically install interior drain tile, sump pumps with battery backup, and vapor barriers BEFORE finishing. We also recommend backwater valves to prevent sewer backups.
What is basement build-up and when do I need it?
Basement build-up raises the finished floor level to work around low ceiling heights or plumbing lines, common in older Chicago homes with 6'6"–7' basement clearance. It's evaluated during your free assessment and priced into your overall proposal.
What if my basement has low ceilings?
Chicago code requires 7'0" minimum ceiling height. Options include underpinning ($15,000-$40,000) or creative design solutions. We'll evaluate during your free assessment.
Do you offer basement carpentry without a full remodel?
Most of our basement work is part of a full design-build remodel — framing, trim, and built-ins are handled by our in-house team as one project, not billed as standalone carpentry, so materials and labor stay under one accountable warranty.
How long does a basement remodel take?
Basic finishing: 4-6 weeks. Complete with bathroom: 6-10 weeks. Luxury builds: 10-14 weeks. Add 2-5 weeks for Chicago permits.
What ROI can I expect?
In Chicago, basement finishing delivers 65-70% ROI at resale. A $70,000 remodel can add $45,000-$50,000 in home value.
Are you basement builders near me on the North Shore and in Chicago?
We serve Chicago city neighborhoods (Lincoln Park, Wicker Park, Lakeview, Logan Square, Bucktown, West Loop, Roscoe Village) plus Winnetka, Wilmette, Kenilworth, Glencoe, Highland Park, Lake Forest, Northbrook, Evanston, and Deerfield from our two Chicago locations.
Do you work in the suburbs?
Yes! We serve Oak Park, Evanston, Skokie, Wilmette, and parts of the North Shore. Suburban permits are often faster (1-2 weeks).
